products.short_description: Run the adoption, change-management & training program for a Google Workspace transformation — champions, an OCM plan, role-based training (incl. Gemini where licensed), hypercare, and adoption metrics — so a 150k-user move actually sticks. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Turn a Google Workspace cutover into real, measured adoption

A technically flawless migration still fails if 150,000 users don't change how they work. This solution is the adoption, change-management & training program: stakeholder and champion networks, an OCM plan (awareness → training → reinforcement), role-based learning paths (Gmail/Drive/Docs/Meet/Chat, and Gemini where licensed), a support/floorwalker model for hypercare, and adoption metrics — the human side that makes the M365→Google move actually stick.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run Python (gcloud / Cloud Client Libraries).

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the OCM model: stakeholders, champions, the awareness→training→reinforcement arc, role-based paths, hypercare, and adoption measurement.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (migration/rollout plan, exec sponsorship, comms channels, training capacity, metrics source).
  • Implementation Guide — build the champion network, run the comms/awareness campaign, deliver role-based training, stand up hypercare/floorwalking, and track adoption — wave-aligned to the migration, pilot-first.
  • 5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or provisioning helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/guardrail check, and a scope/config helper — authentic gcloud / Cloud Client Library automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
  • Validation gates (training delivered, hypercare staffed, adoption metrics trending up) plus Best Practices for sustaining adoption post-cutover.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A Google Workspace move that sticks — champions engaged, users trained by role, hypercare staffed, adoption measured and climbing — the human side of a 150k-user transformation done right.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • adoption_config_check.py — verify the adoption-measurement setup is present and SAFE (read-only)
    • adoption_metrics_report.py — pull Google Workspace adoption/usage metrics (read-only) and trend them
    • champion_roster_planner.py — build wave-aligned champion cohorts and check coverage ratio
    • hypercare_theme_analyzer.py — rank hypercare ticket themes and check floorwalker staffing
    • training_completion_tracker.py — compute per-role training completion and apply the go-live gate

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all Python scripts and tools in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
